input.content:
# Order Platform

This workspace describes the architecture of the Order Platform, a system that
accepts customer orders, persists them, and charges payment via an external
Payment Gateway.

## Files

- `workspace.dsl` — main entry point; pulls in the model and views with `!include`
- `model.dsl` — people, systems, containers, and relationships
- `views.dsl` — system context and container views
- `docs/` — Markdown documentation for the workspace

## Views

| View | Key | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| System Context | `order-platform-context` | How the Customer interacts with the Order Platform |
| Container | `order-platform-containers` | The containers that make up the Order Platform |
